ContextQuery.description: The query. See the module docs for an example.

groupBy.description: Count matches per value of this key (every item of a list counts).

match.description:
Shorthand: `{ "status": ["todo", "review"], "team": "default" }` — a
scalar is `eq`, an array is `in`.

select.description:
Frontmatter keys to return (plus the built-in row fields). Include
`"relationships"` to also get relationship refs. Omitted: everything.

sort.description: Sort keys, applied in order; ties fall back to path. Default: path.

text.description: Token-aware title, heading and body match (bounded scan).

EventSpec.description:
An event trigger: `agent_done` (an agent finished), `inbox_idle` (an agent sits
idle at its prompt with unread inbox mail) or `role_pending` (a message is queued
for a role inbox in reach of the routine).

from_agent.description:
`agent_done` only: only an agent this names finishing fires it; read like
[`RoutineDef::agent`].

role.description: `role_pending` only: watch this queue; omit to watch every queue in reach.

FilterClause.description: One filter clause. Clauses on the same key OR together; different keys AND.

key.description:
Any frontmatter key, or a built-in field (`path`, `relPath`, `fileName`,
`id`, `org`, `team`, `layer`, `kind`, `mtime`, `title`, `parentEpic`).
Matching ignores case, `-`/`_` and camelCase vs snake_case.

value.description:
The operand for `eq`/`in`/`not`/`contains`/`prefix`. `"@me"` stands for the
signed-in user.

oneOf.description: Equals none of `value` (a scalar or an array). Files without the key match.
The key is present and non-empty.
The key is absent or empty.

A list field has an item equal to `value`, or a text field contains it —
both ignoring case. A JSON-number `value` matches numerically instead.

`min <= value <= max` (either bound optional). A value only matches bounds
of its own kind: numbers numerically, ISO dates chronologically, text
naturally; a numeric bound never matches a date or text.

FullSort.description:
The object form of a sort key. Unknown fields reject, so a typo such as
`direction` fails loudly instead of sorting ascending.

HandoverFrom.description: A machine a routine moved off, until it acknowledged the disarm.

Kind.description:
What a file is, by the existing classification rules (frontmatter `type`,
file extension, location).

Layer.description: Which layer of the context footprint a file lives in.

oneOf.description: The user's private space for one org. Only ever returned for its own org.
Content that applies in every org (e.g. the CodeSense docs bundle).

MetadataCondition.description: Selection and predicates share the context query wire model and comparator.

list.description: An authoring hint for list wording; matching always uses the query engine.

Migrated.description: The legacy file a routine was migrated from.

from.description:
The legacy dir relative to the space's `config/`: `routines/<id>`.
The legacy content last brought forward (the 3-way merge base for an
older client's edits) is kept beside the routine, in
`migrate::BASE_FILE`, so mirroring it never rewrites this file.

note.description: Shown with the routine: why it was renamed on the way (an id clash).

revision.description:
The revision the move wrote: the editor says why the routine
starts a new session only until a later revision is saved.

MissingOrder.description: Where files without a value for the sort key go. Default: last.

max_runtime.description:
Required. `30m` / `2h`, between one minute and a day. Optional on the wire
only so a missing value is a typed validation error.

max_wakes.description:
Optional, set by the routine's author (usually an
agent): how many deliveries its wakes may make in all. Reached, the
routine pauses itself with one inbox note; resuming starts a new count.

max_wakes_per_day.description:
Deliveries in any rolling 24 h. Over it a fire is
`undelivered(limit_reached)`; it resumes on its own.

min_gap.description:
The least time between two wakes of this routine, into any session (`30m`,
`2h`, `1d`; at most `7d`), for wakes that start heavy work. A fire
inside it is coalesced or skipped per `overlap`.

RelationshipFilter.description:
Relationship predicates. Each token is a path, a `story_id`, a file name or a
file stem. All given predicates AND together.

backlinkedBy.description: This lists the file in its `supporting_docs`.

dependedOnBy.description: This depends on the file (the file is a dependency of it).

parentEpic.description: The file's parent epic (`parent_epic`/`epic` frontmatter, or a folder on its path).

RoutineTrigger.description:
One trigger. On the wire it is a single-key map: `- schedule: {…}` or
`- event: {…}`.

ScheduleSpec.description:
A wall-clock schedule: a 5-field cron in an IANA zone (see
[`super::schedule`]). A missing `tz` is filled with this machine's zone at
save and persisted, so it never changes with where the app later runs.

SortSpec.description:
One sort key: `"status"`, `"-mtime"` (descending), or the object form.
`order` ranks values explicitly (e.g. a team's own status order); values
not listed sort after the listed ones. It also orders `groupBy` buckets
when the group key is sorted on.

Variable.description:
A declared task variable. `default` is required when any trigger is a
schedule, because nobody is there to supply a value.

Where.description: Where the run happens. `kind` is `team_workspace` or `repo:<owner>/<repo>`.

machine.description:
Which machine runs it: `local`, `any` or a team-shared machine id;
absent means local.

WhereScope.description: Where to look. Every dimension narrows; omitted means unconstrained.

orgs.description: Orgs to search. Default: every synced org. All-orgs content matches any org.

pathGlob.description: A glob over the path relative to the content root (e.g. `**/DEMO-*.md`).

pathPrefix.description: An absolute path prefix, or a prefix of the path relative to the content root.

sameOrgAs.description:
Limit to the org of the content root this absolute path (a file or a
folder) sits under — a UI default, e.g. a `csquery` block searching its
own org. Fails closed: a path under no org's root (all-orgs content, or
outside the footprint) leaves only all-orgs content.

sameRootAs.description:
Limit to the one content root (a team's context repo, a private space, or
all-orgs content) this absolute path sits under — e.g. a team board
listing its own team's stories. Nothing matches when the path is under no root.

teams.description: Team names. Private and all-orgs files have no team, so naming teams excludes them.

description: One routine definition, exactly as stored in `routine.yml`.

agent.description:
The agent that runs the task; see [`AgentRef`]. A routine stored under
its agent (`config/agents/<agent>/routines/<id>/`) does not write it: the
path names the agent and every read fills it in (`layout`). Only a
legacy `config/routines/<id>/` file or an `_unassigned` one carries it.

archived_with_agent.description:
Archived because its agent was archived: restoring the agent offers to
restore exactly these (`lifecycle`).

arm_epoch.description:
Bumped on every move of the routine between a desktop and a
machine. A machine refuses an arm or disarm older than the epoch it
holds, so a stale definition can never re-arm it there.

armed_host.description:
The local host id of the one Mac that arms this routine, so it fires
once however many machines have it. Placement, not permission: anyone
may move it. Unset only in a definition written outside CodeSense; see
`host::is_armed_here`.

armed_machine.description:
The team-shared id of the machine whose session server arms this
routine: it fires there on the machine's own clock, with or
without a desktop. `armed_host` then names the Mac that manages the
arm (pushes it, and records its runs); no Mac fires it itself. Old
clients carry it as an unknown key.

handover_from.description:
The machine this routine moved off and the epoch of that
move, until that machine acknowledged it stopped firing it. No Mac
fires the routine meanwhile (it may still fire there), whichever Mac
reads this; the Mac that manages it clears it once acknowledged.

migrated.description: Where a migrated routine came from (`migrate`).

mode.description:
What a fire does: `fresh` starts a new instance of the agent, `wake`
delivers the task into a live one (starting one only when
none is running). Blank when the author picked none: the default is worked out
at fire time (`service::effective_mode`); migration writes `fresh`.
Kept as a string so an unknown value is a
typed [`ValidationError`]; see [`RoutineDef::mode`].

owner.description:
The principal who created this routine, for display and attribution.
It grants nothing: anyone who can see a routine can change it.

result_schema.description: Optional bounded inline JSON Schema for a private dashboard snapshot.

runs_on.description:
How a team routine runs: `one_mac` (the default, also when empty) runs
it once for the team on the `armed_host` Mac; `each_mac` runs it on
every Mac whose user turned it on there, each with its own runs. Kept
as a string so an unknown value is a typed [`ValidationError`]; see
[`RoutineDef::runs_on`].

title: RoutineDef
